sentences.zh: 而且他是个非常风趣的人。

sentences.en: Really, really liked working with him.
sentences.zh: 真的，我非常喜欢和他共事。

sentences.en: Well, you know, we are both watching Matlock and we are loving it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们俩都在看《马特洛克》，而且我们都非常喜欢。

sentences.en: I mean, everyone is loving it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，每个人都喜欢它。

sentences.en: Kathy, it is just taken off like wildfire.
sentences.zh: 凯西，它简直火得一塌糊涂。

sentences.en: And we would love to talk to you about it.
sentences.zh: 我们很想和你聊聊这部剧。

sentences.en: Well, I'm happy to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 好啊，我很乐意聊聊。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're where the numbers are just crazy.
sentences.zh: 是啊，收视数据简直疯狂。

sentences.en: They were just off the charts.
sentences.zh: 简直高得离谱。

sentences.en: And the best part about it is that everybody involved with it, whether it's the president of the studio, Amy Reisenbach, who's been our big fan.
sentences.zh: 最棒的部分在于所有参与其中的人，无论是工作室总裁艾米·雷森巴赫，她一直是我们的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: And David Staff, the president of the studio, and George Sheeks, who's kind of over all of us in Paramount.
sentences.zh: 还有工作室总裁大卫·斯塔夫，以及派拉蒙负责统筹我们的乔治·希克斯。

sentences.en: They're all so normal, you know, and they're accessible.
sentences.zh: 他们都非常平易近人，你知道，很容易沟通。

sentences.en: They communicate and they send emails and, you know, they came to our last table read.
sentences.zh: 他们会交流，会发邮件，而且，你知道，他们还参加了我们上一次的剧本围读。

sentences.en: And I've never had that happen before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未遇到过这种情况。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's Jenny Ehrman, who created Jane the Virgin.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有创作了《处女情缘》的珍妮·厄曼。

sentences.en: And she's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 她是个天才。

sentences.en: Her mind works like a Rubik's Cube.
sentences.zh: 她的思维就像魔方一样灵活。

sentences.en: And the layers that she's created in this series is just fascinating.
sentences.zh: 她在本剧中构建的层次感简直令人着迷。

sentences.en: And I'm also an executive producer on the show.
sentences.zh: 我也是这部剧的执行制片人。

sentences.en: So they send me the episodes to take a look at, see if I have any suggestions.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会把剧集发给我看，看看我有没有什么建议。

sentences.en: And I mean, it's just I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我简直等不及了。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: I can't wait for what's coming up.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想看接下来的剧情了。

sentences.en: So when I first met Jenny, you know, I first read the script and as I was reading along, it seemed like it was just episodic, you know, that it was a case of the week.
sentences.zh: 所以当我第一次见到珍妮时，你知道，我刚读完剧本，读的时候觉得这只是单元剧，你知道，就是每周一个案子那种。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the twist at the end.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，结尾有个反转。

sentences.en: And I was thrilled because I think, OK, now this is about substance.
sentences.zh: 我当时激动坏了，因为我想，好吧，这下有深度了。

sentences.en: It's about something.
sentences.zh: 这剧有内涵。

sentences.en: It's about something meaningful.
sentences.zh: 它探讨了一些有意义的东西。

sentences.en: It's something I can really sink my teeth into.
sentences.zh: 这是我真正可以大展拳脚的角色。

sentences.en: And I read it on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 我是周五读到剧本的。

sentences.en: I met with her on a Monday and I said, don't change a word.
sentences.zh: 我周一和她见了面，我说，一个字都别改。

sentences.en: I want to do this.
sentences.zh: 我想演这个角色。

sentences.en: And then we started talking about the character and where it was going and the the who she was, where she came from, all of the things,
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始讨论这个角色，讨论她的走向，她是谁，她从哪里来，所有这些细节，

sentences.en: how she had planned this all out with her grandson, you know, and it was it was fascinating.
sentences.zh: 她是如何与孙子一起筹划这一切的，你知道，这真的太迷人了。

sentences.en: I just I didn't I've never imagined playing a character like this.
sentences.zh: 我只是……我从未想过自己会扮演这样的角色。

sentences.en: Well, you're really playing two characters, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你实际上是在演两个角色，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you're playing this sort of like.
sentences.zh: 所以你演的是这种……

sentences.en: Like, explain that to people, because if you watch the first episode, if you watch the pilot, it's one of the best pilots of anything I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 给大家解释一下吧，因为如果你看了第一集，也就是试播集，那是我看过最棒的试播集之一。

sentences.en: I remember seeing the pilot for Breaking Bad and thinking, wow, that was a great pilot.
sentences.zh: 我记得当年看《绝命毒师》的试播集时，心想，哇，这集拍得真好。

sentences.en: And I felt the same way when I saw the pilot for Matlock.
sentences.zh: 看《女律师马特洛克》的试播集时，我也有同样的感觉。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The twist at the end is genius.
sentences.zh: 结尾的反转简直是天才之作。

sentences.en: But you had me from the minute you stood at that coffee counter.
sentences.zh: 但从你站在咖啡柜台前的那一刻起，你就已经抓住我了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you're bumbling.
sentences.zh: 你表现得笨手笨脚的。

sentences.en: You get a guy to pay for your coffee.
sentences.zh: 你让别人帮你付咖啡钱。

sentences.en: You get the candies.
sentences.zh: 你拿了糖果。

sentences.en: You put your candies in your hand.
sentences.zh: 你把糖果抓在手里。

sentences.en: And you trick your way in to this law firm into their boardroom into a job.
sentences.zh: 然后你用计混进了那家律师事务所，进了他们的董事会，还得到了一份工作。

sentences.en: It is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: I think so, too.
sentences.zh: 我也这么觉得。

sentences.en: I mean, I had to keep asking Jenny questions about, is this possible?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不得不一直问珍妮问题，比如，这真的可能吗？

sentences.en: Well, I remember asking a friend of mine who's in corporate law, not corporate law, but he's in the corporate world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得问过我的一位朋友，他在企业法领域工作，不，不是企业法，但他身处企业界。

sentences.en: He's a dear friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 他是我的一位挚友。

sentences.en: I said, could you do this?
sentences.zh: 我说，你能做到这样吗？

sentences.en: Could you do this?
sentences.zh: 你能做到吗？

sentences.en: And he thought about it for a minute.
sentences.zh: 他思考了一会儿。

sentences.en: He said, yeah, I could.
sentences.zh: 他说，能，我能做到。

sentences.en: And then I don't have kids.
sentences.zh: 而且我没有孩子。

sentences.en: So I talked to my niece.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了我的侄女。

sentences.en: She has a daughter who's now grown.
sentences.zh: 她有个女儿，现在已经长大了。

sentences.en: And I said, but could you do this?
sentences.zh: 我说，你能做到这样吗？

sentences.en: Could you be this, you know, devious and deceitful and lie to people all the time for your daughter?
sentences.zh: 为了你的女儿，你能变得如此狡猾、虚伪，并一直对人撒谎吗？

sentences.en: And she said, yes.
sentences.zh: 她说，能。

sentences.en: She said, when you're a mother, your love for your child is savage.
sentences.zh: 她说，当你成为母亲，你对孩子的爱是野蛮而强烈的。

sentences.en: And I love, of course, the fact that she's older.
sentences.zh: 当然，我非常喜欢她年纪较大这一点。

sentences.en: I would never have believed that I could have done a series like this at my age, been asked to do one.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过自己在这个年纪还能演这样的剧集，还能受邀出演。

sentences.en: And that we've gotten letters from people, from women who say, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多人的来信，来自那些女性，她们说，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: I don't feel invisible anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不再觉得自己是个隐形人了。

sentences.en: I think that you'll see as the series goes on that Matlock is really falling in love with being a lawyer again.
sentences.zh: 我想随着剧集的发展，你会看到马特洛克真的重新爱上了当律师的感觉。

sentences.en: You know, she was in mourning for years and years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她哀悼了整整好多年。

sentences.en: And then her grandson saw this Reddit post and said, you know, this is a way to get back at them.
sentences.zh: 然后她的孙子看到了那篇Reddit帖子，说，你知道，这是报复他们的好办法。

sentences.en: You know, she can plan everything she wants.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她可以筹划她想要的一切。

sentences.en: But she doesn't expect to be a trial lawyer.
sentences.zh: 但她没料到自己会成为一名出庭律师。

sentences.en: And you find out later on in the third episode that she, you know, went into a contract law because of a sexual abuse experience.
sentences.zh: 后来在第三集你会发现，她是因为曾经遭受过性虐待，才选择了合同法。

sentences.en: And instead of going into litigation, which is what she really wanted.
sentences.zh: 而不是去从事她真正想做的诉讼工作。

sentences.en: And I'm jumping all over here.
sentences.zh: 我有点跳跃了。

sentences.en: But that was the seminal moment for her, that she was really able to make a difference, that she was able to remember her own sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 但那是她人生中决定性的时刻，她终于能够有所作为，能够正视自己曾遭受的性侵经历。

sentences.en: And it changed her opinion about what young women go through nowadays.
sentences.zh: 这改变了她对当今年轻女性所经历之事的看法。

sentences.en: And it also shows not just the sexual assault, which is what we all talk about and how bad that is and how prevalent that is.
sentences.zh: 它不仅展现了性侵犯——这是我们都在讨论的话题，也谈到了它的恶劣程度和普遍性。

sentences.en: But it talks about what happens then, what happens after.
sentences.zh: 它还探讨了在那之后会发生什么，后续的影响。

sentences.en: Do you make a different career choice for women that are trying to get into show business and they get into a really bad situation?
sentences.zh: 对于那些试图进入演艺圈却陷入极其糟糕境地的女性，你会为她们做出不同的职业选择吗？

sentences.en: What happens to them after that?
sentences.zh: 在那之后她们会经历什么？

sentences.en: And in this case, we see Maddie taking a divergent path, one that she wasn't happy with.
sentences.zh: 在这个案例中，我们看到麦迪选择了一条不同的道路，一条她并不快乐的道路。

sentences.en: And she didn't realize that until she met this young woman.
sentences.zh: 直到她遇见这个年轻女孩，她才意识到这一点。

sentences.en: So the fact that she's learning all of this from everyone is a very powerful thing to say in an episodic television show on network.
sentences.zh: 所以，她在每个人身上学到这一切，这在电视网播出的剧集中是一个非常有力的表达。

sentences.en: I was going to say the idea, you know, I'm 53, but I'm still discovering things about myself and that life is a discovery.
sentences.zh: 我正想说这个想法，你知道，我53岁了，但我仍在探索自我，生活本身就是一场探索。

sentences.en: You don't age out of discovery.
sentences.zh: 你不会因为年龄增长而停止探索。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes we dismiss that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时我们忽略了这一点。

sentences.en: We think that we can't discover new things about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们认为自己无法再发现关于自我的新东西。

sentences.en: And I've really connected to that in this show.
sentences.zh: 而我在这个节目中真正体会到了这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: That's a really good point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的观点。

sentences.en: Every time I do something, I want to learn from it.
sentences.zh: 每次我做某件事，我都想从中学习。

sentences.en: And one of the most valuable things, as I was saying, being an exec producer and being able to see the cuts, I'm learning things about my acting, like bad habits, you know,
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，最宝贵的事情之一就是作为执行制片人能够看到剪辑片段，我正在学习关于我表演的东西，比如坏习惯，你知道，

sentences.en: that I want to change without restricting myself.
sentences.zh: 我想在不限制自己的前提下做出改变。

sentences.en: But we're always learning.
sentences.zh: 但我们总是在学习。

sentences.en: We're always evolving as artists, as people.
sentences.zh: 作为艺术家，作为个人，我们总是在进化。

sentences.en: We're trying to learn from our experiences.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图从经验中学习。

sentences.en: And seeing that happen in a show like this is so, I think that's one of the reasons people are so attracted to it.
sentences.zh: 看到这一切在这样的节目中发生，我想这就是人们如此被它吸引的原因之一。

sentences.en: And it's people from all walks of life, which is what I really like.
sentences.zh: 而且这是来自各行各业的人，这正是我真正喜欢的。

sentences.en: I feel so grateful that everyone on the show, I think that even the crew, there was a sense when we came back to do episode two, because it was the first time we'd shot in America.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常感激，节目组的每个人，我想甚至包括剧组工作人员，当我们回来拍摄第二集时，有一种特别的感觉，因为这是我们第一次在美国拍摄。

sentences.en: We shot the pilot in Toronto.
sentences.zh: 我们在多伦多拍摄了试播集。

sentences.en: So when we came back to do it here, there was just this buzz and this excitement about getting ready to do the show.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们回来这里拍摄时，那种为准备节目而产生的热烈氛围和兴奋感油然而生。

sentences.en: And the crew, you could feel it on the set.
sentences.zh: 剧组工作人员，你在片场就能感受到。

sentences.en: It was just, it was, it was new to me to feel that.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说，这是一种全新的感受。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, we would all go around looking at each other or even the day players or the guest cast that would come in would just be looking at us going, oh my God.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我们都会环顾四周看着彼此，甚至连临时演员或客串演员进来时，都会看着我们说，天哪。

sentences.en: We can't believe it's like this.
sentences.zh: 我们简直不敢相信会是这样。

sentences.en: We've never worked on a show like this.
sentences.zh: 我们从未参与过这样的节目。

sentences.en: So it's not just the material that we're putting out for everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是我们呈现给观众的内容。

sentences.en: It's also the experience of doing it every day and the joy of connecting and being vulnerable to one another so that the work really blossoMs.
sentences.zh: 这也是每天参与其中的体验，以及那种相互连接、彼此坦诚所带来的快乐，让作品真正绽放光彩。

sentences.en: And if you learn something about yourself, all I can say is I'm grateful.
sentences.zh: 如果你能从中了解自己，我只能说我很感激。

sentences.en: I'm just so grateful to have this experience.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激能有这次经历。

sentences.en: Well, the way you talk about it and the way your face lights up and the way you talk about the people and the crew and the experience,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你谈论它的方式，你脸上洋溢的神采，以及你谈论演员、剧组和这段经历的方式，

sentences.en: it just reminds me so much of working on The Office.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了在《办公室》工作时的情景。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Doesn't it you, Angela?
sentences.zh: 你不觉得吗，安吉拉？

sentences.en: Yeah, so much, especially, Kathy, when you were talking about how exciting it is to get the scripts and have an input.
sentences.zh: 是的，太像了，尤其是凯西，当你谈到拿到剧本并能提出意见是多么令人兴奋时。

sentences.en: You know, there was such a creative collaboration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是一种非常棒的创意协作。

sentences.en: Greg Daniels set the tone for that, that we could go to the writers and we could pitch ideas to them.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·丹尼尔斯定下了基调，我们可以去找编剧，向他们提出想法。

sentences.en: And that was so powerful and meaningful even as a supporting cast member.
sentences.zh: 即使作为配角，那也是非常有力量和意义的。

sentences.en: So I love that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: And you see it in the work.
sentences.zh: 你可以在作品中看到这一点。

sentences.en: You see the creative collaboration.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到那种创意协作。

sentences.en: It's why we're hooked from the minute you're on screen.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们从你出现在屏幕上的那一刻起就被深深吸引。

sentences.en: The cast is so fantastic.
sentences.zh: 演员阵容太棒了。

sentences.en: I really love the caSt.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这个演员阵容。

sentences.en: And we can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我们已经迫不及待了。

sentences.en: You know, we'll keep talking about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们会继续讨论它的。

sentences.en: Well, I felt like for a minute, I felt you were talking about The Office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一瞬间我感觉你是在谈论《办公室》这部剧。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: You know, because it's the same way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为感觉是一样的。

sentences.en: I mean, you guys, you were full-blown people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你们当时就是活生生的人。

sentences.en: And there was, as you said before, you're living.
sentences.zh: 正如你之前所说，你们是在真实地生活。

sentences.en: That's what I'm always saying to Jenny.
sentences.zh: 我总是对珍妮这么说。

sentences.en: I don't want to play Maddie.
sentences.zh: 我不想扮演麦迪。

sentences.en: I want to be Maddie.
sentences.zh: 我想成为麦迪。

sentences.en: So that's what you guys were doing.
sentences.zh: 所以你们当时就是这么做的。

sentences.en: And the feeling on the set of The Office is, I thought you were talking about you guys.
sentences.zh: 而《办公室》片场的那种感觉，我原以为你在说你们剧组。

sentences.en: It's the same thing.
sentences.zh: 是一样的。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It's the same thing.
sentences.zh: 是一样的。

sentences.en: Well, you know, we also would love to talk to you about your advocacy work
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们也想和你聊聊你的倡导工作，

sentences.en: and your recent health journey.
sentences.zh: 以及你最近的健康历程。

sentences.en: And I know Jenna had reached out to you.
sentences.zh: 我知道珍娜联系过你。

sentences.en: And I would love to start that part of this conversation.
sentences.zh: 我很想从这部分开始我们的谈话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Jenna, can you tell me where you are in terms of your...
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你能告诉我你现在的状况吗……

sentences.en: I know I heard that you have breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 我知道我听说你患了乳腺癌。

sentences.en: Could you tell me a little bit about where you are in that journey?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说你现在的治疗进展吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I was diagnosed last December, December 2023.
sentences.zh: 我是去年十二月，也就是2023年十二月被确诊的。

sentences.en: In January, I had a lumpectomy.
sentences.zh: 一月份，我做了肿块切除手术。

sentences.en: And then I had a reconstructive surgery.
sentences.zh: 然后我做了重建手术。

sentences.en: I had a breast reduction and lift.
sentences.zh: 我做了缩胸和提拉手术。

sentences.en: And what they were able to do was take some of my own breast tissue
sentences.zh: 他们能够利用我自身的一些乳房组织，

sentences.en: and sort of fill in the hole where they removed the cancer.

sentences.en: Well, it all boils down to, someone once told me, you have to have a head like a bullet and
sentences.zh: 嗯，归根结底，曾经有人告诉我，你必须拥有像子弹一样坚硬的头脑，

sentences.en: a heart like a baby.
sentences.zh: 和像婴儿一样柔软的心。

sentences.en: And I could expand on that by saying, especially nowadays, with social media being so powerful
sentences.zh: 我可以补充一点，尤其是在当今社交媒体影响力如此巨大，

sentences.en: and powerful in negative ways, is that you really have to be, you have to get strong.
sentences.zh: 且负面影响也如此强大的情况下，你真的必须变得强大。

sentences.en: You have to get tough and at the same time, not get cynical or bitter, but you've got to
sentences.zh: 你必须变得坚强，同时又不能变得愤世嫉俗或满腹牢骚，你必须

sentences.en: protect yourself.
sentences.zh: 保护好自己。

sentences.en: I don't advocate being on social media unless, in your case, it's a great thing for your
sentences.zh: 我不提倡使用社交媒体，除非像你这种情况，这对你的

sentences.en: show.
sentences.zh: 节目很有帮助。

sentences.en: You need to do that.
sentences.zh: 你需要那样做。

sentences.en: But I don't want to read negative things about myself.
sentences.zh: 但我不想读到关于我自己的负面评价。

sentences.en: I just think that the best kind of advice I could give is, if you're serious about being
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我能给出的最好的建议是，如果你是认真想成为

sentences.en: an actor, if you want to be an actor like Cillian Murphy or Anthony Hopkins or Cate
sentences.zh: 一名演员，如果你想成为像基里安·墨菲、安东尼·霍普金斯或凯特·

sentences.en: Blanchett, you have to study.
sentences.zh: 布兰切特那样的演员，你就必须学习。

sentences.en: You have to work.
sentences.zh: 你必须努力工作。

sentences.en: You can't just be, it's wonderful to be young and to be given an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅是……年轻并获得机会固然很好。

sentences.en: And if you've got that spark, if you've got it and you can really sail out there, that's
sentences.zh: 如果你有那种天赋，如果你真的能驾驭它并闯出一片天地，那

sentences.en: great.
sentences.zh: 很棒。

sentences.en: And then I'd say, protect your heart.
sentences.zh: 然后我会说，保护好你的心。

sentences.en: Don't let your heart get hurt by strangers who say things about you or your work.
sentences.zh: 不要让你的心被那些对你或你的作品指手画脚的陌生人所伤害。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because work is what got us here.
sentences.zh: 因为工作才是让我们走到今天的原因。

sentences.en: Work is what kind of keep us here.
sentences.zh: 工作也是让我们留在这里的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like you guys were talking about the collaborative aspect of your work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像你们刚才谈到的工作中的协作层面一样。

sentences.en: And that was the focus of what you did.
sentences.zh: 那是你们所做工作的核心。

sentences.en: And that's what made it so wonderful.
sentences.zh: 也正是这一点让它变得如此美妙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: I feel like it's sometimes hard to be an artist because you do have to keep that open
sentences.zh: 我觉得作为一名艺术家有时很难，因为你必须保持那颗开放的

sentences.en: heart in order to do the work.
sentences.zh: 心才能完成工作。

sentences.en: But that makes it so that you're, I don't know, it's so easy to get wounded when you have
sentences.zh: 但这让你变得……我不知道，当你拥有那颗开放的心时，

sentences.en: that open heart.
sentences.zh: 太容易受伤了。

sentences.en: So it's such a balance.
sentences.zh: 所以这真是一种平衡。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a gift to be porous.
sentences.zh: 保持敏感是一种天赋。

sentences.en: It works great in your work, but it's not so great in the world outside.
sentences.zh: 它在你的工作中效果很好，但在外面的世界里却不那么好用。

sentences.en: It can be difficult.
sentences.zh: 这可能会很困难。

sentences.en: But I remember a producer, because I got very hurt one time in London by an awful interviewer,
sentences.zh: 但我记得有位制片人，因为有一次我在伦敦被一位糟糕的采访者伤害得很深，

sentences.en: and I literally left the tour.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的退出了巡回宣传。

sentences.en: And I remember the producer coming to me and saying, you're going to have to get a lot tougher.
sentences.zh: 我记得那位制片人来找我说，你必须变得更坚强一些。

sentences.en: You're going to have to toughen up.
sentences.zh: 你必须让自己硬起来。

sentences.en: But, you know, and he was right.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他是对的。

sentences.en: Anyway, I appreciate being able to chat with you in a very open and safe way.
sentences.zh: 总之，我很感激能以一种非常开放和安全的方式与你交谈。

sentences.en: And I think we talked about some wonderful things.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们聊了很多很棒的话题。

sentences.en: And I'm so happy for you.
sentences.zh: 我真为你感到高兴。

sentences.en: Oh, well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Happy for you, Jenna, that you're, that you've come through this.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，真为你感到高兴，你终于挺过来了。

sentences.en: Kathy, it was, it was such an honor to work with you.
sentences.zh: 凯西，能和你共事真是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, you did something at our first table read together that I never forgot.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我们在第一次围读剧本时，你做了一件事，我至今难忘。

sentences.en: You sat down at the table, and you had the script, and you got out a golden folding fan,
sentences.zh: 你坐在桌边，拿着剧本，然后掏出一把金色的折扇，

sentences.en: the kind that you go like, and you would fan yourself because you were hot, you know?
sentences.zh: 就是那种“唰”地一下打开，因为觉得热就扇风的那种，你记得吗？

sentences.en: And I thought to myself, one day, I am going to earn the right to fan myself with a golden fan.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，总有一天，我也要赢得用金扇子扇风的资格。

sentences.en: And so, Kathy, my goal in life is to win a Tony.
sentences.zh: 所以，凯西，我的人生目标就是赢得托尼奖。

sentences.en: I want to do a Broadway show.
sentences.zh: 我想演一部百老汇剧目。

sentences.en: I want to win a Tony.
sentences.zh: 我想拿个托尼奖。

sentences.en: And when I walk up on that stage to accept my award, I am going to get out a golden fan,
sentences.zh: 等我走上领奖台发表获奖感言时，我会掏出一把金扇子，

sentences.en: and I am going to fan myself in your honor.
sentences.zh: 然后以你的名义扇扇风。

sentences.en: I'll wait for that.
sentences.zh: 我会等着那一天的。

sentences.en: I really will.
sentences.zh: 真的会等。

sentences.en: I'm excited for you to do that.
sentences.zh: 我很期待你做到那一点。

sentences.en: Angela, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，太感谢你了。

sentences.en: It was great speaking with you today.
sentences.zh: 今天和你聊天很愉快。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Kathy.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，凯西。

sentences.en: You're a light in the world, and we just adore you.
sentences.zh: 你是这世上的一道光，我们都特别崇拜你。

sentences.en: So thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你给我这个机会。

sentences.en: Bye, guys.
sentences.zh: 再见，伙计们。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I just loved all of that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢刚才的一切了。

sentences.en: I loved just spending time with her.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢和她待在一起的感觉。

sentences.en: I really felt like we got to spend time with her.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得我们和她共度了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And I just love how happy she is in this new job, in this new chapter of her life.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢她现在这份新工作，喜欢她人生新篇章中展现出的那种快乐。

sentences.en: You and I can really relate to that.
sentences.zh: 你和我对此真的深有同感。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Matlock, you guys, airs on CBS every Thursday at 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 各位，《马特洛克》每周四晚9点在CBS播出，

sentences.en: Eastern, and it's also streaming on Paramount Plus, and it's already been picked up for a second season.
sentences.zh: 东部时间，也可以在派拉蒙Plus上观看，而且已经续订了第二季。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Angela, we also said we would share a swipe up in our stories where people can learn more about lymphedema.
sentences.zh: 对了，安吉拉，我们之前也说过，会在快拍里分享一个链接，让大家了解更多关于淋巴水肿的信息。

sentences.en: And I would also like to include a link to the Breast Cancer Risk Assessment TeSt.
sentences.zh: 我还想附上一个乳腺癌风险评估测试的链接。

sentences.en: It is a test that you can take online at home to calculate your risk for developing breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你可以在家在线完成的测试，用来计算你患乳腺癌的风险。

sentences.en: And it's kind of based on your age, breast density, family history.
sentences.zh: 它主要基于你的年龄、乳房密度和家族病史等因素。

sentences.en: And if you have an increased risk, you can share those results with your doctor, and you might qualify for additional diagnostic testing.
sentences.zh: 如果你发现风险增加，可以把结果告诉医生，或许你就有资格进行额外的诊断测试。

sentences.en: For example, if you are at a high risk, but you're younger than 40, you might qualify for an annual mammogram much sooner.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你属于高风险人群，但年龄不到40岁，你可能就有资格提前进行年度乳房X光检查。

sentences.en: I have said before that my success with treatment is due to my very early detection, so it's really worth taking the teSt.
sentences.zh: 我之前说过，我治疗成功是因为发现得非常早，所以这个测试真的很值得一做。

sentences.en: Yeah, so important.
sentences.zh: 没错，非常重要。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, thanks for listening today.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，感谢大家今天的收听。

sentences.en: We're going to be back with you on Friday with a special holiday bonus episode.
sentences.zh: 周五我们会带着一期特别的节日加更节目回来。

sentences.en: Yeah, we can't wait.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们已经迫不及待了。

sentences.en: It's really festive.
sentences.zh: 真的很有节日气氛。

sentences.en: It's really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And we just hope you guys have a great week.
sentences.zh: 我们衷心希望大家能度过愉快的一周。

sentences.en: Know that we're thinking of you.
sentences.zh: 请记住，我们一直挂念着你们。

sentences.en: And we'll see you Friday.
sentences.zh: 我们周五见。

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。
